info.title: Heron Broadcaster API
info.description: Control plane of Heron Broadcaster. Sign in with `POST /api/v1/auth/login` (session cookie, plus an `X-Requested-With` header on requests that change something) or send an API token as `Authorization: Bearer heron_…`.

put.summary:
Moves a name to another artist (or to a new one): the tracks tagged
with it follow. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Links waiting for review.

post.summary: Accepts or dismisses a suggestion. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Artists, by name.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Matches any of the artist's names.

patch.summary: Renames an artist, or sets its MusicBrainz ID. Operators and admins.

post.summary:
Merges another artist into this one: its names, tracks, similar
artists and restrictions. Operators and admins.

put.summary:
Marks two artists similar: separation treats them as the same artist.
Operators and admins.

post.summary: Signs in: answers with the user and sets the `heron_session` cookie.

429.description: Too many failures for this username

post.summary: Signs out: ends the session and clears the cookie.

get.summary: The signed-in user.

put.summary: Changes your password. Your other sessions are signed out.
Saves your preferences: the web UI's theme, language and width.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

put.summary:
Renames, recolors a category, changes its type, its separation or
whether the FX player offers it. Operators and admins.

delete.summary:
Deletes a category and its restrictions; its tracks stay in the
library. Refused while a clock uses it. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Every category type, in the order they were created.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

put.summary: Renames a type, or changes its rules. Operators and admins.

delete.summary: Deletes a type no category uses. Operators and admins.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

A clock as it will sound, from its slots (saved or not): expected
starts and lengths, and the categories running short.

put.summary: Renames a clock and replaces its slots. Operators and admins.

delete.summary:
Deletes a clock; the hours it was scheduled at rotate the whole library
until another clock is scheduled. Operators and admins.

post.summary: Adds an encoder profile. Admins only.

put.summary:
Replaces an encoder profile. Outputs using it restart with the new
encoding. Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes an encoder profile no output uses. Admins only.

get.summary: Every EQ preset, by name.

post.summary: Saves gains as a new preset. Operators and admins.

put.summary:
Renames a preset or saves new gains in it. The EQs it was loaded into
keep their gains. Operators and admins.

delete.summary:
Deletes a preset. The EQs it was loaded into keep their gains.
Operators and admins.

get.summary: Plays, most recent first.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Plays started before this time (Unix ms), for the next page.

parameters.name: after
parameters.description: Plays started at or after this time (Unix ms).

parameters.name: exclude_fx
parameters.description: Leave out the FX player (jingles played over the music).

get.summary: Every label, with how many tracks have it.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

put.summary: Renames or recolors a label. Operators and admins.

delete.summary: Deletes a label: its tracks lose it. Operators and admins.

post.summary:
Merges a label into another: its tracks get the other label, and it is
deleted. Operators and admins.

get.summary: The most recent batches of file operations, newest first.

post.summary:
Reverts a batch: files go back to their previous paths and get their
previous tags back. Nothing is overwritten: a file whose previous path
is taken stays where it is (see the task's report). Admins.

Applies an import: sets each track's values, puts tracks in categories,
labels them, disables them, as one transaction that can be undone.
Admins only.

Matches an export's rows to library tracks and says what an import would
change. Writes nothing. Admins only.

get.summary: The last imports, newest first. Admins only.

post.summary:
Undoes an import: every track gets back what it had before it, as one
transaction. Categories and labels it created stay. Admins only.

Fetches the programming details of identified tracks from MusicBrainz
(album, record label, ISRC, first release year, genres), one release a
second. From then on, new tracks are looked up in the background.
Operators and admins.

Asks for a dry run of organizing the library with the layout in the
library settings: the task's `plan` lists every move, nothing changes.
Admins.

Carries out the moves of a finished dry run, as one batch that can be
undone. Tracks moved since the dry run are skipped. Admins.

get.summary:
Tracks whose identification was not confident enough to apply, with the
releases they may be on.
Import and analysis progress. No sign-in needed.
The most recent library tasks, newest first.
A library task, with its result once done.
Tracks in the trash, most recently deleted first.

post.summary:
Purges the whole trash now: the tracks and their files are removed for
good; their plays keep their artist and title. Admins.

Restores the tracks of a deletion (undoes its batch): their files go
back where they were, with their analysis, categories and history. A
path taken since is reported, and that track stays in the trash.
Operators and admins.

get.summary:
Totals per hour, day, week or month: distinct listeners, peak, average,
listening hours, sessions. Today's change until midnight.

parameters.name: output_id
parameters.description: Only this output; the whole station otherwise.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Rows per hour, day (by default), week or month.

get.summary:
Each hour of the day (station time), averaged over the days of the
period.

parameters.name: output_id
parameters.description: Only this output; the whole station otherwise.

get.summary: Each output's listeners at the last minute, and the station's.

Sessions and listening hours by player (user agent), most listened
first.

parameters.name: output_id
parameters.description: Only this output; the whole station otherwise.

get.summary:
Listeners minute by minute. Minutes no server could be read are
missing.

parameters.name: to_unix_ms
parameters.description: Until this time (Unix ms), at most 8 days after `from_unix_ms`.

parameters.name: output_id
parameters.description: Only this output; the whole station otherwise.

get.summary:
Tracks of the period, those listeners left the most first (by
departure rate, or by the change of listeners without sessions).

parameters.name: min_plays
parameters.description: Tracks played fewer times are left out, 3 by default.

get.summary: Opens the live WebSocket. Messages are [`LiveMessage`]s.

parameters.name: levels
parameters.description: Send levels ten times a second (default true).

get.summary: Every medley, by name.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

put.summary:
Changes a medley's recipe (applied on its next build). Operators and
admins.

delete.summary:
Deletes the recipe; the rendered track stays in the library. Operators
and admins.

get.summary:
Every track that can be a part of `kind`, with the span it would take,
by artist and title: to choose one. Operators and admins.

parameters.name: slot
parameters.description: Where the liner goes, for a liner: `between` by default.

schema.description:
Where a liner goes in a medley: its liners come from a category of
their own at the start and at the end, when the settings have one.

post.summary:
A new medley with the same recipe and parts, not rendered (no name
until it is). Operators and admins.

Another hook or liner, none of `exclude`, to replace one in a plan.
Operators and admins.
Picks the parts from the recipe, without saving them. Operators and admins.

get.summary: The last preview's audio (WAV), with range requests.

post.summary:
Mixes the parts into the medley's preview, outside the library: nothing
is saved. Operators and admins.

Saves the parts as the medley's version, names the medley after its
hooks and asks heron-librarian to mix them into its file. Operators and
admins.

get.summary: Outputs with their live state.

post.summary:
Adds an output; the engine starts streaming to it if it is enabled.
Admins only.

put.summary:
Replaces an output. Credentials left out of `config` are kept, and so
are the statistics settings when `statistics` is left out. Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes an output; the engine stops streaming to it. Admins only.

get.summary: Decks, queue and outputs, read from the engine now.

post.summary:
Plays a library track on the FX player, over the music. Replaces the
FX playing, if any.

get.summary: Peak and RMS levels (dBFS) of the master bus and each deck.

post.summary: Fades out and holds the decks; the stream goes on with silence.
Fades out the track on air and starts the next one.

Plans the transition between two tracks the way the engine would, for
previews. Nothing is played.

get.summary:
What was played, most recent first, the FX player and tracks that send no
metadata (jingles) left out. No sign-in needed; any website may read it.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Plays started before this time (Unix ms), for the next page.

get.summary:
The track on air; while a track that sends no metadata (a jingle) is on
air, the last one that does. No sign-in needed; any website may read it.

What comes next, in airing order: the music only (no FX player, no
tracks that send no metadata), at most 10. No sign-in needed; any
website may read it.
The tracks waiting to play, in order: the cued one first.

post.summary:
Queues library tracks. Missing files and tracks with nothing audible are
refused.

delete.summary:
Empties the queue, cued track included. The track on air plays on (and
autofill, when on, queues new tracks).
Takes an entry out of the queue. The track on air cannot be removed: skip it.

put.summary: Moves a waiting entry.

post.summary: Operators and admins.

put.summary: Operators and admins.

get.summary: The selection log, most recent first.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Picks before this one, for the next page.

post.summary:
Generates programming offline, without touching the queue, and checks
it: separation as relaxed at each pick's step, restrictions always.
Operators and admins.

get.summary: Which clock runs when; hours left out rotate the whole library.

put.summary: Replaces the whole schedule. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Gap Killer and crossfade point detection, used at import.

put.summary:
Replaces the analysis settings. Every track is analyzed again with the
new settings, in the background. Admins only.

get.summary: Both deck EQs.

put.summary:
Replaces both deck EQs and pushes them to the engine at once, where
they glide in. Every open live WebSocket gets an `eq` message.
Operators and admins.

get.summary: Identification and folder layout, used by `heron-librarian`.

patch.summary: Changes some library settings; the others are kept. Admins only.

get.summary: The medley settings.

put.summary:
Replaces the medley settings (missing fields take the defaults). Tracks
already rendered keep their categories. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Crossfades and loudness normalization.

put.summary:
Replaces the playout settings (missing fields take the defaults) and
pushes them to the engine. Admins only.

get.summary: What counts as a play, eras, and the mood and sound code scales.

put.summary:
Replaces the programming settings (missing fields take the defaults).
Tracks keep their mood and sound code when a scale changes. Operators
and admins.
Replaces the queue manager settings. Operators and admins.

get.summary: Separation rules, the fallback category and weights.

put.summary:
Replaces the rotation settings (missing fields take the defaults).
Operators and admins.
Replaces the station settings. Admins only.

get.summary: Listener statistics: the minimum session, how long sessions are kept.

put.summary:
Replaces the listener statistics settings (missing fields take the
defaults). A new minimum session recomputes the totals the sessions
kept still cover. Admins only.

get.summary:
The buffer zone: groups with files to import or discard, with their
identification, flags and planned paths.

post.summary:
Removes files from the buffer zone (uploads in progress too). They never
reached the library. Files being imported are left alone. Operators and
admins.

Prepares files of the buffer zone for when they are imported: the
categories, labels, mood and sound code their tracks get. Files being
imported, or no longer in the buffer, are refused. Operators and admins.

Edits the tags files of the buffer zone are imported with (title,
artist, album, album artist, year, track, disc), on top of those they
get from their identification, a release picked by hand or their own
tags. heron-librarian works their path out again. Files being imported,
or no longer in the buffer, are refused. Operators and admins.

get.summary: A file of the buffer zone, to listen to it. Supports range requests.

post.summary:
Imports a file as one of its candidate releases, or with its own tags:
heron-librarian works out its tags and path again. Operators and admins.

Starts an upload: its files are identified together, so the files of an
album agree on their release. Operators and admins.

Imports files ready in the buffer zone: heron-librarian tags them and
files them in the library as one batch, which can be undone. Files that
are not ready are skipped (see the task's report). Operators and admins.

Announces a file of an upload: it is created empty, and its content is
sent in chunks. Refused when it is not audio, when it is larger than
`max_upload_mb`, or when it would leave less than `min_free_mb` on the
disk. Operators and admins.

get.summary:
A file of an upload, with the bytes received so far: send the rest from
there.

put.summary:
Appends a chunk (at most 16 MiB) to a file being uploaded, at `offset`,
which must be the bytes received so far (409 otherwise: ask for the
file and carry on from its `received`). With its last byte, the file is
complete and heron-librarian identifies it. Operators and admins.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Where the chunk goes in the file: the bytes received so far.

get.summary:
Whether the API, its database and the engine are up, and whether the
server clock can be trusted. No sign-in needed.
Your API tokens (not revoked). The tokens themselves are never shown again.

post.summary: Creates an API token acting as you, with your role.

delete.summary: Revokes one of your API tokens (admins: anyone's).

get.summary: Library tracks, searched, filtered and sorted, a page at a time.

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Words found in the title, artist, album, album artist, genre or path.

parameters.name: labels_all
parameters.description: Tracks with every one of these labels (IDs, comma-separated).

parameters.name: labels_any
parameters.description: Tracks with at least one of these labels.

parameters.name: labels_none
parameters.description: Tracks with none of these labels.

parameters.name: not_played_days
parameters.description: Tracks not played for this many days (including those never played).

parameters.name: added_days
parameters.description: Tracks added in the last this many days.

parameters.name: batch_id
parameters.description: Tracks created by this import batch (an import from the buffer zone).

parameters.name: bitrate_below
parameters.description: Tracks whose bitrate is below this many kbps.

get.summary:
Each track's categories, for up to 200 tracks: what the decks and the
queue show. Unknown tracks are left out.

post.summary:
Puts every selected track in categories, or takes them out. Filling a
category from a label: select with `filters.labels_any`. Operators and
admins.

Moves tracks to the trash: heron-librarian moves their files to
`.heron-trash/` in the library, as one batch. They leave the library,
rotation, their categories and the queue (a track on air plays to its
end), and are purged after `trash_days`; until then they can be
restored whole. Tracks whose file is missing can be deleted too.
Operators and admins.

Disables or enables every selected track. Tracks already waiting in the
queue stay there. Operators and admins.

Adds labels to, and removes labels from, every selected track.
Operators and admins.

Sets the mood, sound code or tempo of every selected track. Operators
and admins.

Edits the tags of the selected tracks in Heron's database only, when
the library setting `write_tags` is off: the files are not changed.
The values are shown instead of the files' tags, and survive a rescan,
until they are cleared. Operators and admins.

Drops the tags kept in Heron's database for the selected tracks (at most
10,000): they show their files' tags again. Works whatever `write_tags`
says. Operators and admins.

Writes tags into the files of the selected tracks (at most 10,000), as
one batch that can be undone: queues a library task for
heron-librarian. Files are not moved. Operators and admins.

get.summary:
A track with its details, analysis, overrides, categories and
identification.

patch.summary: Enables or disables a track. Operators and admins.

get.summary:
The track's audio file as it is in the library, for previews in the
browser. Supports range requests.

put.summary: Replaces the track's categories. Operators and admins.
Sets the track's hook (its most recognizable part). Operators and admins.

Sets where the track's intro ends (the vocals start): jingles of a type
playing over the intro end there. Operators and admins.

Replaces the track's overrides: cue points, Gap Killer, crossfade.
Missing fields use the analysis and station settings. Queued entries of
the track are updated within seconds. Operators and admins.

delete.summary: Removes the track's overrides. Operators and admins.

post.summary:
Applies one of the track's candidate releases: heron-librarian writes
its tags into the file and files it where the layout says, as a batch
that can be undone. Operators and admins.

Marks the track as reviewed: its file keeps its own tags. Operators and
admins.

get.summary:
The track's waveform overview, computed with its analysis. 404 until
the track is analyzed.
Every user. Admins only.

post.summary: Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes a user with their sessions and tokens. Admins only.

patch.summary:
Changes a user's role, enables or disables them, or resets their
password. Admins only.

post.summary:
Sends a delivered or failed delivery again, with every attempt again.
Admins only.

get.summary: Webhooks, by name. Admins only.

post.summary:
Adds a webhook. The answer holds its secret, shown only this once.
Admins only.

put.summary: Replaces a webhook; its secret is kept. Admins only.

delete.summary: Deletes a webhook and its deliveries. Admins only.

get.summary: A webhook's deliveries, most recent first. Admins only.

parameters.name: before
parameters.description: Deliveries older than this one (its ID), for the next page.

post.summary:
Gives a webhook a new secret, shown only this once; deliveries not sent
yet are signed with it. Admins only.

Sends a `ping` delivery now, whether the webhook is enabled or not.
Admins only.

AnalysisSettings.description:
Parameters of the import-time analysis (Gap Killer and crossfade point
detection). Stored under the `analysis` settings name.

Levels are in dB **relative to the track's integrated loudness**, so the
same thresholds work for quiet and loud masters. See `docs/analysis.md`.

blip_max_ms.description: Bursts of sound this short, surrounded by silence, are ignored.

end_threshold_db.description: Audio quieter than this at the end of a track is trimmed.

fade_max_ms.description: Longest distance between the crossfade point and the end of the track.

fade_min_ms.description: Shortest distance between the crossfade point and the end of the track.

fade_trigger_db.description: The crossfade starts after the last moment the track is louder than this.

max_internal_silence_ms.description: Silence longer than this inside a track ends the track there.

silence_ceiling_dbfs.description:
Absolute ceiling (dBFS) for what counts as silence: quiet but audible
passages above it are never trimmed, whatever the track's loudness.

start_threshold_db.description: Audio quieter than this at the start of a track is trimmed.

similar.description: Separation treats these as the same artist.

by_hand.description: Moved to this artist by hand.

finished_at_unix_ms.description: `None` while it runs, or when it was interrupted.

undoes.description: For an undo, the batch it undoes.

BatchReport.description: What a batch of file operations did.

skipped.description: Operations not done, with the reason.

unchanged.description: Files that needed no change (their tags already had the values).

free_bytes.description: Free space on the buffer folder's disk.

groups.description: Groups with files still to import or discard, newest first.

min_free_bytes.description: Uploads are refused below this much free space.

add.description:
Categories every selected track is put in (with this weight, also
for tracks already in them).

remove.description: Categories every selected track is taken out of.

fx_player.description:
Liners, power intros, voice tracks: the FX player's picker opens on
these categories. Clocks still call them like any other.

separation.description:
Windows this category overrides; the others follow the rotation
settings (clock slots can override them again).

total_ms.description:
How long its tracks last together, in ms: what is played of each
(cue-in to cue-out, overrides applied), or the file's length for a
track not analyzed yet. Over the same tracks as `tracks`.

type_id.description: What it holds (`GET /category-types`); none when unset.

weight.description: Relative chance of being picked within the category, 1 by default.

fx_player.description: Not for the FX player by default.

type_id.description: A category type; none by default.

CategoryRef.description: A category, as the decks and the queue show it.

weight.description: Relative chance of being picked within the category, 1 by default.

no_two_in_a_row.description:
Never two tracks of this type in a row: rotation passes a slot
calling it over right after one.

plays_over_intro.description:
Its tracks play on the FX player over the next track's intro, ending
where the vocals start, when that intro is long enough.

sends_metadata.description:
Its tracks send metadata to the stream servers. Off (jingles, ads):
the stream and the public now-playing keep the last song's, and
webhooks send them only when they include the FX player.

no_two_in_a_row.description: Kept as it is when missing (off for a new type).

plays_over_intro.description: Kept as it is when missing (off for a new type).

sends_metadata.description: Kept as it is when missing (on for a new type).

oneOf.description: One of the file's candidate releases.
Keep the file's own tags.

looping.description: Off by default: the clock starts over at each hour.

duration_ms.description: Expected length of the whole clock.

runs_per_hour.description:
How many times the clock runs in an hour: more than 1 when it is
shorter than the hour; under 1 for a looping clock longer than it.

ClockSlot.description: How a slot calls its category.

enforce_rules.description: Off, the slot skips the separation rules (restrictions still apply).

separation.description: Windows this slot overrides, over its category's.

estimated_error_ms.description: The kernel's estimate of the clock's error, in ms.

offset_ms.description: The offset the kernel is correcting, in ms.

synchronized.description: `None` where the kernel's state cannot be read (not Linux).

warning.description:
Why the clock cannot be trusted, for people. `None` when it is fine
or unknown.

looping.description: Carries on from its last slot across hours instead of starting over.

scheduled_hours.description: Hours of the week it is scheduled at.

token.description: Send it as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`. Shown only once.

CreatedWebhook.description: A new webhook, with its secret: the only time it is shown.

CrossfadeOverrides.description:
Per-track crossfade overrides (`track_overrides.crossfade`). Missing fields
use the station settings. The fade-out, mode and fixed time apply to the
transition out of the track; the fade-in to the transition into it.

crossfade.description: `false` plays the transition out of this track back to back, without overlap.

CrossfadeSettings.description:
Station-wide crossfade settings, modeled on SAM Broadcaster's
"Cross-Fading" screen. Stored under `playout` in the `settings` table.

fade_out.description: Fade-out of the outgoing track, from the moment the next one starts.

fixed_ms.description: With [`CrossfadeMode::Fixed`], how long before the cue-out the next track starts.

min_track_ms.description:
Tracks this long or shorter (jingles, IDs) are never crossfaded: they
start right after the previous track and the next starts right after them.

skip_fade_ms.description: Fade-out of the current track when it is skipped.

DeckEq.description: One deck EQ. Flat and bypassed by default.

gains_db.description: Gain of each band in dB, from 60 Hz up, −12 to +12.

oneOf.description: Missing when the deck is empty.

on_air.description: The track listeners hear as "now playing".

last_response.description: The start of the receiver's last answer.

DetailsReport.description: What a MusicBrainz details lookup did.

failed.description: Lookups that failed (tried again next time).

all.description: Look up every identified track again, not only those never looked up.

discarded.description: Files removed from the buffer zone.

EffectivePlayout.description: How the engine will play the track: analysis and overrides combined.

gain_db.description: Loudness normalization gain with the current playout settings.

enabled.description: Off: autofill, clocks and medleys never pick the tracks.

EngineStatus.description: Whether the engine is reachable and runs the stored configuration.

position.description: Where among the waiting tracks, 0 being next. At the end when missing.

track_ids.description: Library tracks, played in this order.

gains_db.description: Gain of each band in dB, from 60 Hz up.
Gain of each band in dB, from 60 Hz up, −12 to +12.

music.description: Decks A and B: they take turns, so they share one EQ.

Explanation.description: Why a track was picked: the selection log.

at_unix_ms.description: When the track is planned to start (Unix ms).

blocked.description:
Tracks of the slot's category held back by each separation rule
with the rules as configured (the first rule that applies counts).

oneOf.description:
Category the track was picked from: the fallback category from
step 9; missing for the whole library.
Missing when no clock is scheduled: the whole library rotates.

last_played_unix_ms.description: When the picked track last played; missing if never.

method.description: Applied: least recently played at step 10.

skipped_slots.description: Slots passed over because nothing could be picked, even relaxed.

slot.description: Index of the slot in the clock, from 0.

oneOf.description: Category the slot calls.

weight.description: Weight of the picked track in its category.

windows.description: Separation windows applied at this step.

level_pct.description: Level the fade-out goes down to, or the fade-in starts from, in percent.

hook_in_ms.description:
Where the hook starts and ends, in ms on the file's timeline; both
`null` remove it.

HourOfDay.description: An hour of the day, over the days of a period.

average.description: Mean of the listeners over the minutes measured.

days.description: Days with a minute measured in that hour.

listening_hours.description: Listening hours, on average per day.

rows.description: The values to set on each track, conflicts settled.

can_schedule.description: The other software never schedules it.

heron_category_id.description: The Heron category of the same name, if there is one.

ImportCategoryChoice.description: What an export's category becomes in Heron.

disable_tracks.description: Its tracks are disabled: rotation never picks them.

fx_player.description: Offered by the FX player (set when the category is created).

name.description:
The Heron category its tracks go in, created if missing; none leaves
them out of any category.

type_id.description: Its type (`GET /category-types`), set when the category is created.

ImportField.description:
A value Heron may already have, set in Heron: a conflict when the
import's differs.

ImportProblemChoice.description: What an export's problem becomes in Heron.

label.description: The label's name, created if missing.

conflicts.description: Fields set in Heron that the import would change.

current.description: What Heron has set itself, for the same fields.

length_mismatch.description: The lengths differ by more than 2 s: probably another edit.

line.description: 1 for the first row of the export.

source_length_ms.description: The export's length of the file.

warnings.description: Values of the export left out, and why.

ImportSourceRow.description:
One audio file of the other software's export. Times are in seconds, on
the timeline of the file the software measured them on; 0 means "not
set". Unknown fields are ignored.
